# Shopify Partner Directory

> A directory of commerce service partners, searchable by service, location and industry.

Browse partner summaries, service areas and direct contact details on their individual pages. Partner-provided information should be confirmed with each business before making a decision. This site is an independent directory and is not an official Shopify property.

## Pages

- [Partner directory](/): Browse and filter listed commerce partners.
- [Brainboxworld](/experts/brainboxworld): View services, location and contact details.
- [Gillco Digital](/experts/gillco-digital): View services, location and contact details.
